easyPrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lutri, adding one mana of any color.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana of each color that you didn't add in step 5.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
